title: When the WhatsApp group stops working
music: About one minute of original, warm, confident instrumental background music for a short explainer film: West African guitar, soft hand percussion, warm bass and gentle keys, around 96 BPM, steady under a voice, no vocals, a resolved ending.
vo: Almost every Nigerian estate runs on a WhatsApp group. It's free, everyone has it, and it's great for conversation.
But a group chat wasn't built to run an estate. Payments get lost in the scroll, notices get buried, and nobody can find last month's decision.
With BreeUp, every household is billed on schedule, and you can see who has paid at a glance.
Official notices reach the right homes, on WhatsApp and in the resident portal, and they stay on record.
So keep the group for conversation, and move the things that need a record into BreeUp.
